title: astracantha divaricata
intro: Astracantha divaricata, commonly known as Astragalus divaricatus, is a type of flowering plant in the legume family, Fabaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote overall health and well-being, with health benefits that include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Astracantha divaricata include antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic properties, attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Astracantha divaricata include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
